$howToUse: One file per blend. Copy this file, rename it to the blend slug, fill it in, and send it
with the image files in the same folder. Keep the folder structure and the file names.
Check it before sending:  node tools/validate-intake.mjs <yourfile>.json
It reports every problem at once, in plain terms, and it takes about a second.
Field by field guidance, lengths and image sizes: see the content intake specification.
Leave a value as null if you do not have it yet. Do not invent one, and do not delete
the key: a null tells us it is outstanding, a missing key tells us nothing.
Nothing in this file is marketing copy we can write for you. Content writing,
photography and translation are outside our scope, so a blank here stays blank.
